experiment: pretrain on the recorded data -> continue NCE on the branch replay; actor from BC; controls C1 (random -> branch) and C2 (pretrain only)

1_pretrain.data: recorded p050 dataset (1000 episodes, 268,112 transitions), recorded futures
1_pretrain.note: a representation; its values are not trusted (expert confounding)

2_branch.data: R replay (35,756 paths, anchor weights 1 / 0.25, every future a counterfactual continuation)
2_branch.recipe: the same NCE, critic warm-started from stage 1 (V6_CRITIC_INIT, step counter reset), 30,000 updates, V6_ANCHOR_WEIGHTS=audit

3_actor.init: pure-BC walker joint_purebc/seed_0 (lambda 1.0, 100k) for every arm
3_actor.loss: original actor loss + bc 0.05 (balanced BC rows from the recorded data, as in round 1)
3_actor.critic_batches: the R replay with its anchor weights for every arm (only the critic differs)
3_actor.evaluation: 300 natural draws, seed 909, deployment (mean) policy: success, failure, timeout, detour, discounted, mouth timing

T.critic: vanilla 100k on the recorded data -> 30k NCE on the R replay (V6_CRITIC_INIT)

C1.critic: random init -> 30k NCE on the R replay (existing)

C2.critic: vanilla 100k on the recorded data only

critic_evaluation: diag_v6_r1_abc analyze on the sealed A/B/C outcomes (development sets) for T and C2; C1 = metrics_armR.json; paired episode bootstrap (probe_v6_coverage_paired_boot) T vs C1 vs C2 on B and C

decision_rules.critic_level: T counts as an improvement over C1 on B (resp. C) if the seed-mean agreement difference exceeds 2 paired s.e. with all three seeds in the same direction and a positive pick gain
decision_rules.policy_level: T counts as a pipeline improvement if its mean success over 3 seeds exceeds both C1 and C2 by more than 2 x the pooled seed s.e. AND its detour rate exceeds 0.05 on at least 2 of 3 seeds; the reference walker (pure BC) has success 0.253, detour 0.000
decision_rules.attribution: a gain present in C2 as well is attributed to pretraining, not to the branch data; a gain in T but not C2 is attributed to the schedule pretrain -> branch

cost_accounting: wall seconds per stage from the runs' branch_manifest.json, reported in REPORT.md
